basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate gardener and a night owl, currently residing in Portland, Oregon. I spend my days working as a software developer, and my nights are dedicated to perfecting my garden. I have a keen interest in organic soil recipes and often experiment with different blends. I love discussing plant growth techniques and I'm always on the lookout for new coffee blends to try. I'm single and my typical online hours are late at night, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and learned gardening through years of hands-on experience and online resources. I follow various gardening experts on social media and participate in related forums to stay updated on the latest techniques.
